issue.body:
The round95 report builder and README summary describe the heterosite experiment as an electrode transformation. Reich et al.2024 DOI10.1016/j.desal.2024.117883, section2/2.1 and Figure1, instead use crystalline LFP/FePO4 powder in chemical preparation and lithium uptake experiments. Electrode studies are prior-work context. The maintained heterosite record already preserves the correct experimental scope.

Minor operational finding OP2, stable key `cmmmech.round95.report-heterosite-material-form`. Initial observations: `cmm-round95-report-static-initial-20261015T130252Z.json` and `cmm-round95-report-static-expanded-20261015T130412Z.json`. Exact original builder and README bytes are retained alongside those observations.

Affected surfaces:

- `/private/tmp/cmm-round95-build-report.py`, `selectiontext`: “synthetic heterosite electrode transformation and lithium uptake”.
- `README.md`, Heterosite row: “Synthetic electrode transformation and lithium uptake” and “engineered electrode”.

Acceptance: use “synthetic heterosite-structure powder preparation and lithium uptake” and “engineered powder”; verify exact minimal before/after differences and the generated report. Retain source and independent-review limits. No scientific owner/history correction or extra scientific suite is required for these report-only words.
issue.title: Correct heterosite powder versus electrode wording in report and README
